subject: Anchored commit portfolio and billing pathways — Clearwater Health
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Burst <alex.burst@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Anchored commit portfolio and billing pathways — Clearwater Health

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is an anchored annual commit portfolio designed for Clearwater Health’s staged ramp over 12 months. High-level options inside the PDF:

- Starter: 10M tokens/year, per-token rate $0.00080, 30% first-year onboarding credit, carryover up to 10% unused tokens into next quarter.
- Growth: 60M tokens/year, per-token rate $0.00055, burst pool available up to 2x daily throughput, 10% carryover quarter-to-quarter, 3% early-pay invoice discount.
- Enterprise: 300M tokens/year, per-token rate $0.00035, dedicated reserved capacity, guaranteed burst headroom, SLA-backed latency tiers, custom quant/ops plan.

Key billing pathways we proposed:
- Monthly billing with smoothing credits (recommended for cashflow sensitive orgs).
- Quarterly invoicing with upfront partial payment to lock rates.
- Annual prepay (largest unit discount + free onboarding credits).

Also included are: a short retention & audit log addendum, a one-page ramp schedule that ties token commit to expected 95th percentile RPS, and an example fallback policy if a region is constrained.

Please review with your procurement and let me know which pricing pathway you want us to formalize into a SOW. If helpful, I can produce a version with a blended overage cap (e.g., 1.25x capped overage rate) and breakpoints for mid-year usage shocks.

Attachments: 2026-08-29_Anchored_Commit_Portfolio.pdf (PDF), Clearwater_Initial_SOW-v1.docx (DOCX)

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Burst <alex.burst@clearwaterhealth.com>

Cc: procurement@clearwaterhealth.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Anchored commit portfolio and billing pathways — Clearwater Health

Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clean deck. A few clarifying questions from our side before we escalate to procurement:

1) Burst behavior: if we hit burst pool beyond the included daily headroom, is the overage at the same per-token rate as the ladder or is there a premium? We need predictable caps for budget purposes.
2) Carryover: you mention "10% carryover" on Starter/Growth. Is carryover consumed before we bill overages?
3) Refunds/credits: if you miss a latency SLA tied to our peak routing, what is the remediation (credits / service days)?
4) Sizing: can you suggest a conservative ramp profile for Growth that prevents frequent overage in Q1?

Procurement is copied for any T&Cs questions. If this looks reasonable I can route to them, but I want the answers above to avoid multiple rounds.

—Alex
Alex Burst
Director, AI Platforms | Clearwater Health
alex.burst@clearwaterhealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Burst <alex.burst@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Anchored commit portfolio and billing pathways — Clearwater Health

Alex —

Great questions, thanks. Short answers up front, then granular detail below.

1) Burst overage pricing: we implement a two-tier approach — burst usage up to the agreed headroom is included at the commit per-token rate. Beyond headroom, overage is billed at a capped premium of +40% above the commit per-token rate (we can negotiate to +25% for Growth/Enterprise with a minimum commit). We can also offer a blended monthly overage cap (e.g., net effective rate not to exceed $0.0009 for Growth).

2) Carryover ordering: carryover tokens are consumed first before any overage billing. Carryover expires after the following fiscal quarter (we can extend to 2 quarters for Enterprise).

3) SLA remediation: our standard Hosted API SLA includes service credits for region-level sustained latency or availability misses (credit ladder documented in the SOW). For Enterprise customers we offer a 6% service credit per major incident that breaches the agreed regional uptime for the month, up to 30% monthly credit cap; we also provide prioritized on-call escalation.

4) Conservative ramp for Growth: recommend Q1 = 10–15% of annual commit, Q2 = 25–30%, Q3 = 25–30%, Q4 = 30–35%. That profile keeps typical burst events within the included headroom while preserving runway for marketing-driven traffic spikes. See attached (1-page ramp schedule).

I'm attaching a short appendix with worked examples for Growth on a 60M token commit showing monthly billing, implied $/month, and worst-case overage exposure under our capped premium model. If you'd like, Marissa can propose a final incentive (one quarter of carryover as onboarding credit) if you sign by Oct 15.

Quoted for clarity: 
> Attachments: 2026-08-29_Anchored_Commit_Portfolio.pdf (PDF), Clearwater_Initial_SOW-v1.docx (DOCX)

Let me know if procurement wants an immediate SOW update (we can swap the overage premium to a blended fixed rate for the first 12 months).

Best,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Hi Alex / Procurement team —

Adding a short executive summary to expedite alignment:

- Commercial ask: Clearwater selects one commit pathway and an associated billing cadence; Redwood will produce a narrowly-scoped SOW with explicit overage caps and carryover policy.
- Incentive: sign-by-Oct-15 onboarding credit equal to 1 quarter of Growth tier carryover (applies to Growth only).
- Risk mitigations: 30-day opt-out window if traffic drops >40% vs. committed baseline; blended overage cap option available for first 12 months.

Procurement: if you send a list of must-have contract terms (data residency, encryption, audit log retention), we will call out exceptions and provide redline-ready SOW within 48 hours. Ben — can you confirm the SLA credit ladder and confirm the internal lead for the implementation plan?

Appreciate your time — happy to hop on a quick 30-min call to finalize.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
